universe_selection: Same fixed 100 stocks as protocol_4h_lines.json; no use of retest profitability
higher_line_source: Only completed 1D or 1W candles; no current day/week high/low or projected 4H pivot lines
line_rule: Horizontal outer high/low over last N completed daily or weekly bars; require at least 1 or 2 historical boundary touches within half the median higher-bar range. Current unfinished day/week excluded. Signal only on first rejection at outer boundary and when full channel spans at least 4 signal ATRs.
ema_filter: none = line rejection alone; slope = EMA25 slope sign follows trade; turn = slope changed sign on signal bar. EMA25 touch is not required for retest entry.
exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch closes position on next open; opposite retest can reverse position
control: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch alone, same candles and gross cost model
monthly_review: Continuous account by complete calendar month; report every variant and compare to same-symbol EMA25 baseline. No automatic candidate promotion.
candidate_policy: manual review only; no update to currently running paper strategies
research_status: new outer-zone hypothesis after owner inspected 4H Pine retest noise; all prior history seen
cost_status: gross before commission, spread, slippage, dividends and short borrow; user requested no cost deduction for exploratory pattern search
